title: Disney and Old Navy Are Back With Another Fan-Favorite Halloween Collection Starting at $8
summary: Shop the collection exclusive to Old Navy, featuring clothing and footwear in adult, child and toddler sizes, as well as an adorable pet sweater and Disney accessories.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Halloween is still a few months away, but Old Navy is getting a head start with a new Disney collaboration. While the calendar still says summer, we’re seeing some spooky themes regardless, with hits like Dracula by Jennie and Tame Impala becoming a summer favorite (as evidenced by its appearance in this week’s Hot 100 ) and “Summerween” spreading across retailers.

Now, Disney is jumping on the early Halloween bandwagon. Adding to the existing Old Navy x Disney collaboration , the Haunted Harvest collection is an autumnal lineup inspired by Mickey & Friends. The assortment includes over 40 pieces for adults, kids, toddlers, babies and pets featuring cardigans, pajamas, tote bags, slippers, socks, baby onesies, pet sweaters and more in fall colors, classic plaid prints and playful Halloween-inspired designs. Items start at just $7.99 and go up to $49.99. The collection is exclusive to Old Navy, and the store’s cardmembers get early shopping access on July 30 before the collection goes public the following day.

CARDIGAN

Old Navy x Disney Mickey Mouse Cardigan for Women

Adult & Kids Sizes

$49.99

Buy Now at old navy

This brown Fair Isle cardigan is designed with a garland of Mickey Mouse-shaped pumpkins.

The Old Navy x Disney Mickey Mouse Cardigan is available in regular, tall and petite adult sizes, plus toddler and kids sizes. This relaxed-fit sweater is finished with a crew neck, button front and rib-knit trim. It hits below the waist and is made from a soft cotton blend and recycled materials. Core and Premier Members receive free shipping on qualifying orders.

UNISEX FLANNEL SHIRT

Old Navy x Disney Mickey Mouse Flannel Shirt for Adults

A fall plaid shirt with mini orange Mickey Mouse heads all over.

Available in regular and tall adult sizes plus toddler and kids options, this Mickey Mouse flannel shirt is designed with a loose unisex fit using Old Navy’s standard men’s sizing. It features a spread collar, full-button front, buttoned cuffs and a chest pocket. Made from 100% cotton, it hits at the hip and works well for layering throughout the season.

PET CLOTHES

Old Navy x Disney Mickey Mouse Cozy Sweater for Pets

$24.99

Dogs and cats can join the Disney fun with this Mickey Mouse pet sweater, available in sizes S-XL.

Created from recycled material, the rib-knit trim at the collar, front leg cuffs, and hem provides a comfortable, secure fit. The textured knit includes a Mickey Mouse pumpkin head graphic on the back with a convenient keyhole opening at the neck that allows easy attachment of a harness and leash.

MINNIE MOUSE TEE

Old Navy x Disney Minnie Mouse Boxy Cropped T-Shirt for Women

Available in regular, tall and petite adult sizes along with matching kids options.

This Minnie Mouse graphic T-shirt has an oversized boxy fit, sits at the waist and features elbow-length sleeves with a rib-knit crew neck. Made from 100% cotton, it’s a simple way to add Disney style to casual outfits.

PJ SET

Old Navy x Disney Pajama Shorts Set for Women

Available in regular, tall and petite sizes, this Disney pajama set includes a long-sleeve crew neck top with matching pull-on shorts.

The relaxed-fit shirt falls below the waist while the shorts hit high on the thigh with an elastic waistband. Matching kids styles make family movie nights even more fun. Pair it with the coordinating fuzzy socks to complete the look.

TOTE BAG

Old Navy x Disney Packable Tote Bag

Available in 2 Colors

$9.99

This packable tote comes in two Disney-inspired designs.

One of the designs includes a fall plaid print with Mickey pumpkin icons throughout, and the other is a black tote featuring one oversized orange Mickey pumpkin graphic. The lightweight bag includes sturdy straps, an interior pocket and folds into itself for easy storage. Available in one size and made from machine-washable polyester.

SLIPPERS

Old Navy x Disney Mickey Mouse Sherpa Slippers for Women

Available in 5 Sizes

$26.99

Available in women’s sizes 6 through 10.

These slippers feature a black exterior with a soft orange lining and a Mickey pumpkin design across the front. The slip-on style includes a cozy sherpa upper and textured outsole for indoor wear. Pair them with the Mickey Mouse crew socks available in a brown Fair Isle design or gray from the Haunted Harvest collection.

TRICK-OR-TREAT

Old Navy x Disney Mickey Mouse Mini Bucket Bag

$29.99

Shaped like a Mickey Mouse pumpkin, this mini bucket bag features Mickey’s smiling face on the front with his signature ears on each side.

Inside, the lined interior is finished with an orange and white gingham print for an extra seasonal detail. It works as an everyday pochette or a playful trick-or-treat bag when Halloween arrives.

ALSO FROM OLD NAVY

Old Navy x Disney Mickey Mouse Logo-Graphic Jean Jacket

Limited-Time Deal

$34.99 $69.99 50% off

Part of the existing Disney x Old Navy collection.

This unisex jean jacket is available in regular and tall adult sizes plus matching kids styles . The front features Old Navy embroidery with Mickey’s signature peace sign while the back showcases a large smiling Mickey stencil. Finished with button-flap chest pockets, welt pockets and classic denim jacket details.

JACK SKELLINGTON T-SHIRT

Disney Jack Skellington T-Shirt

$9.99 $19.99 50% off

Another Disney x Old Navy collab from their year-round collection.

This Disney x Old Navy T-shirt features a pumpkin-inspired Jack Skellington graphic with spooky ghosts flying through his oversized eye sockets. Available in regular and tall sizes, the relaxed unisex fit uses Old Navy’s standard men’s sizing. Finished with a rib-knit crew neck and soft cotton jersey, it’s an easy option for Halloween season and beyond.
